annotations.title: Whale tape: $1M+ aggressive sweeps with 24h buy share

description: Call this when the user asks about whale trades, large market orders, or whether big players are buying or selling right now. Returns recent $1M+ aggressive market sweeps recorded live from our own sockets (each row is one sweep: same-side prints on a symbol summed over a short rolling window; a long burst continues in the next row) and 24h aggregates with the buy share.
name: get_whale_tape
